fields.description: Record: a button on the record card. Module: a button above the list (e.g. check in / check out).

fields.options:

fields.description: Set Value: fieldname=value · Server Method: dotted path of a whitelisted function taking doctype and name · Route: a Desk route, {name} is replaced by the record name · Create: JSON of field values for a new record (placeholders {employee} {user} {now} {today} {lat} {lon} {name}); add "__submit": 1 to submit it · Print: a print format name (blank = default) to download the PDF

fields.label: يظهر عند الحالة
fields.description: Blank shows the action on every record; otherwise only on records in that docstatus.
